renderSha256Scope: Original upstream render body before the authorized Bankeiz presentation refinements
integration: The source-carried 36-beat coordinate model, two-hand rotation and solar color interpolation algorithm are retained. Native KKS state supplies the full beat:step:pulse coordinate, independent hand step labels, percentIntoStep fills and continuous day-progress sweep. Authorized Bankeiz refinements enlarge and rebalance the dial on matte navy, add neutral material depth, inherit the original Bankeiz Inter/sans typography, and relocate supplemental readouts and consistent ark captions below. Responsive proportions were informed by the canonical iOS KaiDialView.swift; no iOS timing math is used.
currentArkPaletteSource: Receiz app/components/SigilModal.tsx ARK_COLORS, extracted by Receiz Mind dashboard/build.ts
currentDayPaletteSource: Receiz app/components/SigilExplorer/chakra.ts CHAKRA_COLORS, mapped by native weekdays
authorizedSurfacePalette: The user explicitly authorized deeper muted tones for all presentation colors. BANK_KAI_PALETTE maps ark/day/month/week categories to coordinated light/dark Bankeiz tones; the original category names, indices and canonical hex metadata remain separately preserved in kai-klok.ts. Beat markers retain their original hue positions with reduced saturation. The original solar interpolation algorithm operates on the mapped ark tones. BANK_KAI_SURFACE_COLORS supplies smoky teal/seafoam hardware and readout accents. These are presentation mappings, not claims of unchanged canonical display hex values.
pulseMotion: The orb makes one bounded linear compositor revolution per native eternal pulse. The same held KaiTimeSource is resampled after animation creation; native μpulse phase and the native subdivision period seed both orb and a <=0.15% material-only inhale/exhale. Each native boundary/open/foreground resume reseeds them; hidden/reduced-motion state cancels them. Browser frame scheduling limits visual simultaneity; no second clock, RAF loop, physiological claim, or accumulated CSS period is introduced.
solarCalculationSource: native/receiz/app/utils/kai_pulse.ts sunriseJulianForDate; also canonical /klok SDK. The existing parameterized astronomical calculation is reused locally, with explicit polar non-event rejection.
